phrase.en: Please remove your belt and your laptop. Security is strict here.
phrase.ru: Пожалуйста, снимите ремень и достаньте ноутбук. Здесь строгий досмотр.
phrase.es: Por favor, quítese el cinturón y saque el portátil. Aquí la seguridad es estricta.

text.ru: Просьба — Please + глагол: Please remove your shoes. Запрет — You can't / You mustn't. Необходимость — you have to.
text.en: A request: Please + verb. Prohibition: You can't / You mustn't. Necessity: you have to.
text.es: Please + verbo. You mustn't = prohibido. You have to = es necesario.

examples.en: You have to show your passport.

exercises.en: You have to remove your belt for the check.
